reviewedBy: Dr. K. M. Rahman (Poultry Disease Specialist, DVM, MS)
disclaimer: Indigenous Desi poultry have higher natural foraging capacity but remain susceptible to Newcastle Disease (Ranikhet) and Fowl Pox. Vaccinations are strictly advised.

stages.name: Brooding
stages.feed: Desi Chick Starter Mash (20% crude protein)
tips: Desi chicks benefit from artificial brooding during first 2 weeks to reduce early chick mortality.

milestones.title: Baby Chick Ranikhet Disease Vaccine (BCRDV) Eye-drop
milestones.instructions: Administer 1 drop of BCRDV into one eye per chick. Protect the vaccine from light and heat.

milestones.title: Gumboro (IBD Intermediate) Eye-drop
milestones.instructions: Administer 1 drop of IBD vaccine into one eye.

stages.name: Early Growing
stages.feed: Desi Grower Mash & Broken Grain (17-18% crude protein)
tips: Introduce birds to outdoor sheltered runs during warm, dry daylight hours.
Supply supplemental calcium (fine oyster shell or limestone grit).

milestones.title: Initial Flock Deworming Treatment
milestones.instructions: Administer anthelmintic solution in morning drinking water to control intestinal parasites.

milestones.title: Fowl Pox Wing-Web Puncture
milestones.instructions: Inoculate through wing-web using double-grooved needle applicator. Inspect for 'take' scab 7-10 days later.

milestones.title: Day 35 Growth Check
milestones.instructions: Weigh sample birds (target: 300-360g). Inspect plumage and comb color.

stages.name: Free-range & Finishing
stages.feed: Finisher Mash & Whole Grain Supplement (15-16% crude protein)
tips: Allow daytime scavenging in fenced pastures supplemented with evening grains.
Ensure lockup at dusk in secure, well-ventilated coops.
Keep fresh clean water available in shady spots.

milestones.title: Ranikhet Disease Vaccine (RDV) Booster Subcutaneous Injection
milestones.instructions: Inject 0.5 ml reconstituted RDV vaccine subcutaneously in the lower neck skin using a sterile syringe.

milestones.title: Final Market Harvest Weighing & Batch Close
milestones.instructions: Record final flock live weight (target: 900-1200g) and complete batch closure summary.
